items.statement: The investigation tests multiple physically distinct association hypotheses and preserves candidate identity through validation.
items.expected: Distinct intermolecular contact patterns are generated and compared rather than assuming one site; the source study found seven complex isomers.

items.statement: Every reported low-energy complex candidate has candidate-specific evidence that it is an optimized minimum.
items.expected: The source protocol fully optimized structures and confirmed minima by harmonic frequency analysis; failed or ambiguous tests remain attached to the affected candidate.

items.statement: The independently selected DMSO complex is favorable under a consistent electronic binding-energy convention.
items.expected: For E(complex)-E(L1)-E(IBU anion), the current-paper reference is -42.5 kJ mol-1 in DMSO.

items.statement: The low-energy association motif combines directional carboxylate hydrogen bonding with an aromatic contact.
items.expected: Both carboxylate oxygens hydrogen bond to the two L1 NH donors, and the ibuprofen aromatic ring stacks with an aromatic group attached to the squaramide unit.

items.statement: The predicted lowest-energy absorption feature moves to longer wavelength upon association.
items.expected: The complex has a red-shifted lowest-energy absorption band relative to neutral free L1 without net NH deprotonation.
